title: How do you say...?

objectives.label: Ask for a word you haven't got
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'Kako se reče ___?' with the English word in the slot.

objectives.label: Ask on your own initiative
objectives.descriptorEN: Turn the same question on a second word, without being told to.

objectives.label: Ask for the last word yourself
objectives.descriptorEN: End the conversation by asking how to say 'thank you' — then use the answer he gives you.

frameEN: Slavko has something to show you.
You won't know the word for it — that's the point.
Today you learn how to ask for a word you haven't got.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Ej, ravno prav! Poglej, kaj imam.
n1.en: Hey, just in time! Look what I've got.
n1.deliverySL: [excited] Ej, ravno prav! Poglej, kaj imam.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.deliverySlowSL: [delighted] Odlično … [slower] Točno tako … [deliberately, drawn out] Dežnik.

stallHandlers.label: Ask him to say it again

n4.speaker: npc
n4.deliverySlowSL: [very slowly, drawn out] Dežnik … [very slowly, drawn out] dežnik … [very slowly, drawn out] dežnik.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Aha, počakaj! Ti to slišiš, samo ne veš, kaj to je. Vprašaj me takole: Kako se reče umbrella?
n5.en: Ah, hang on! You can hear it, you just don't know what it is. Ask me like this: How do you say umbrella?
n5.deliverySL: [realizing] Aha, počakaj! Ti to slišiš, samo ne veš, kaj to je. Vprašaj me takole: Kako se reče umbrella?
n5.slowSL: Aha, počakaj … Ti to slišiš … samo ne veš, kaj to je … Vprašaj me takole … Kako se reče umbrella?
n5.deliverySlowSL: [realizing] Aha, počakaj … [slower] Ti to slišiš … [slower] samo ne veš, kaj to je … [slower] Vprašaj me takole … [deliberately, drawn out] Kako se reče umbrella?

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Daj, vprašaj me še kaj! Rain, na primer?
n7.en: Go on, ask me something else! Rain, for instance?
n7.deliverySL: [playfully] Daj, vprašaj me še kaj! Rain, na primer?

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Dež! Pri nas v Ljubljani je dosti dežja, zato imam vedno dežnik, in ko dežuje, grem ven in...
n8.en: Rain! Here in Ljubljana there's lots of rain, so I always have an umbrella, and when it rains I go out and...
n8.deliverySL: [fast, tumbling over himself] Dež! Pri nas v Ljubljani je dosti dežja, zato imam vedno dežnik, in ko dežuje, grem ven in...

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Ha, ja, oprosti! Počasi: dež. Dež. No, moram iti.
n9.en: Ha, yes, sorry! Slowly: rain. Rain. Right, I have to go.
n9.deliverySL: [laughing, then calm] Ha, ja, oprosti! Počasi: dež. Dež. No, moram iti.
n9.slowSL: Ha, ja, oprosti … Počasi … dež … Dež … No, moram iti.
n9.deliverySlowSL: [very slowly, drawn out] Ha, ja, oprosti … [very slowly, drawn out] Počasi … [very slowly, drawn out] dež … [very slowly, drawn out] Dež … [very slowly, drawn out] No, moram iti.

stallHandlers.label: Ask him how to say thank you

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Thank you? Hvala! In hvala tebi! Adijo!
n10.en: Thank you? 'Hvala'! And thank you too! Bye!
n10.deliverySL: [delighted] Thank you? Hvala! In hvala tebi! Adijo!
